steps.action: LibreOffice Calc with a Date/Region/Salesperson/Product/Sales/Cost table; selects it and opens Pivot Table (menu 02.0, Select Source 'Current selection' 03.0, OK)
Pivot Table Layout: 'Data' in Column Fields, Data Fields empty; drags 'Data' toward Row Fields several times (04.5-11.0): it stays in Column Fields
drags 'Data' to Available Fields: it disappears from Column Fields (12.5); clicks OK (14.0)
starts again: Select Source, OK (18.0); layout shows 'Data' in Column Fields (18.5)
drags 'Data' to Row Fields: a no-drop cursor shows at 20.0, 'Data' remains in Column Fields (20.5-21.5)
builds the layout: Salesperson to Filters (25.0), Region to Row Fields (27.5), Sales and Cost to Data Fields ('Sum - Sales', 'Sum - Cost', 30.0-31.5)
drags 'Data' from Column Fields again (33.0-34.5): no change; clicks OK (35.0)
pivot on the sheet: Region rows, 'Data' as column header with Sum - Sales and Sum - Cost side by side
on the sheet drags the 'Data' header cell (B3) down onto the Region area (A6, 48.0): pivot changes to Data in rows, Sum - Sales and Sum - Cost stacked (49.0)
reopens Pivot Table Layout: 'Data' now in Row Fields above Region; drags 'Data' to Column Fields (55.5-58.5): no-drop cursor, it stays in Row Fields; OK (60.5)

actual: Inside the Pivot Table Layout dialog the 'Data' field cannot be moved between Column Fields and Row Fields in either direction: drags at 04.5-11.0, 19.5-21.5 and 33.0-34.5 leave it in Column Fields (no-drop cursor at 20.0), and after it is placed in rows via the sheet, dragging it back to Column Fields at 55.5-58.5 also fails. No message is shown. Dragging the 'Data' header directly on the sheet (45-49) does move the data values into rows. Other fields (Salesperson, Region, Sales, Cost) drag normally.
decisive: 00:20.0: dragging 'Data' over Row Fields shows a no-drop cursor and 'Data' stays in Column Fields, while Region drags into Row Fields fine at 00:27.5
not_visible: the Ctrl key held during the sheet drag (only the drag itself is visible)
notes: 1920x1080, dialog text small but readable at full res; the recorder draws orange circles at clicks, which helps. The first pass (04-14) starts with Data Fields empty, so the 'Sales and Cost as data fields' condition holds only from 31.5 on.
